# The bytes of every local composite action AND every guard program, pinned.
#
# `scripts/check-toolchain-action.sh` verifies this list before anything else in the lint job,
# and the workflow-hygiene lane verifies it again and compares it with the tree.
#
# Review finding [95] put the actions here: refusing a command-file NAME refuses one capability
# out of many, and what the action IS can be pinned instead.
#
# Review finding [108] put the guards here. `pnpm ci:lint` ran `pnpm lint` before the hygiene
# lane, and `eslint.config.js` is top-level code a pull request controls — so it could replace
# `scripts/check-workflow-hygiene.mjs` with a program that exits 0, and the lane would then
# verify nothing while ESLint reported success over the replacement. The lane now runs first, and
# more to the point its own bytes are checked before any of it runs.
#
# `sha256sum -c` format, so the pre-flight needs no parser: two spaces between the digest and
# the path, paths relative to the repository root.
